title: Grateful Dead Live at Bob Marley Performing Arts Center on 1982-11-26
source: (uncertain) Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording praised as the best‑sounding source with a memorable Sugaree intro, though some fans recall the show being a bit of a bummer.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is widely regarded as the clearest version among the four available sources, delivering a solid listening experience. Highlights include the quirky Jamaican intro that leads into Garcia’s “Sugaree” and a strong rendition of the Scarlet‑fire moment, but at least one reviewer felt the overall show was underwhelming.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is consistently praised (good soundboard), while show quality receives mixed feedback (positive highlights vs a comment calling it a bummer). Weighted average yields ~3.8 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the best‑sounding of multiple sources; clear, well‑balanced SBD with no reported dropouts or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not detailed in reviews; includes a notable pre‑song Jamaican spoken intro that transitions into the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia launches into "Sugaree" after a funny Jamaican intro, noted as a highlight.
